description: This file defines the 'Language' controller class for the OpenCart platform, responsible for handling language selection and setup during the startup process.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class responsible for initializing language settings based on URL, request, and configuration within the OpenCart startup process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the language settings based on request parameters and URL route, loads language data, and sets the current language context.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Overrides default language values after initial setup, loads language files for a given route, and manages language-related URL paths.
